title: The Offside Trap — EN/IT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Italian German language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The offside trap is a collective act of confidence
Eleven men stepping forward at exactly the same moment
Trusting that none of them will flinch

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Funziona solo se tutti ci credono [It only works if everyone believes in it]
Un uomo che esita [One man who hesitates]
Un uomo che rimane indietro di mezzo secondo [One man who stays back half a second]
E la trappola diventa un regalo [And the trap becomes a gift]
Un regalo bellissimo e costoso [A beautiful, expensive gift]

[Chorus — English]
The offside trap says — we are one unit, we move together
Step, now, together
One second later — the trap has either worked or it hasn't

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Chas schaute die Abseits-Falle vierzig Jahre lang von den Tribünen aus an [Chas watched the offside trap from the stands for forty years]
Er sagte — Sohn, das ist die optimistischste Sache im Fußball [He said — son, it's the most optimistic thing in football]
Eine Viererkette die sich gegenseitig vollständig vertraut [A back four that trusts each other completely]
Das ist seltener als das, was sie versuchen aufzuhalten [That's rarer than the thing they're trying to stop]

[Verse 3 — English]
The linesman's flag is the verdict — up or down

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
The offside trap
Il fuorigioco [The offside trap]
Die Abseits-Falle [The offside trap]
That's my boy
